overview: The story takes viewers back to Kuzi's past and shows how, after leaving university, he ended up in his native Agapovka and unexpectedly became the head of a local collective farm. This is where his path to big business begins — with all the difficulties, adventures and his cousin's trademark spontaneity. Trying to save the farm from bankruptcy, Kuzya encounters the intrigues of a city businessman who wants to take over the land. In her personal life, too, everything is not easy: a practical neighbor, Verka, a divorced mother with a child, and a spoiled city girl, Dasha, the daughter of that businessman, are fighting for Kuzi's attention. The story unfolds in the format of memories of an already successful Kuzi, about whom the film is being shot, and shows how a simple guy from a dorm turned into a "dumpling king."
title: Кузя. Путь к успеху

overview: Dima, a young dancer, participates in a choreographic show and falls under the influence of a strict mentor, Phil. Together with his girlfriend, he becomes a participant in a psychological experiment that Phil puts on all the wards, testing them for their willingness to become real artists. But the dance show doesn't just change them. Renata is a tough and uncompromising producer who sees dancing exclusively as a business. However, her worldview is crumbling under the influence of the powerful energy of the young dancer Anton. As a result, dancing penetrates deeply into the lives of the characters, making them move in every sense of the word.
title: Искусство падения

overview: In the village of Krasny Kamen, three seventh graders — Roma, Asya and Gordey ― are spending their summer holidays carefree. On one of his trips to the quarry, Roma finds a malachite nugget, with which his drawings become reality. But along with the miraculous find, the ancient spirit Black Raven emerges from the depths of the quarry, which embodies any desire and in return demands to pay too high a price. Now the heroes have to prove that pure thoughts and true strong friendship are stronger than the ancient evil.
title: Малахит

overview: Sasha, raised on Hollywood action movies, is trying to apply his professional skills in a new environment. But life in the countryside is completely different, and you can't understand it with your mind, as they say. The precinct officer will have to figure out the local rules, gain the respect of the residents, gain wit and even find his love in the face of a local milkmaid. And at the same time, he is faced with the case of the mysterious disappearance of a fellow villager, which may not be as simple as it seems at first glance.
title: Участковый Саша

overview: Pavel Valerievich works in the administration of a small village. He is in no hurry, does not dream of the capital and sincerely believes in the principle: "where he was born, he came in handy there." Everything changes when an order comes from Moscow to start a video blog about the activities of the administration. The first issue is so comical and strange that it collects thousands of likes and views. Now Pavel will have to continue filming, which will turn his life and the life of the entire village upside down.
title: Дидюшкино Live

overview: Based on the hit global format, each standalone episode follows a different Real Housewife and real wife as they navigate swapping their everyday comforts and luxuries to fully immerse themselves in a vastly different familial experience. Through unexpected conflicts, eye-opening moments and emotional breakthroughs, the journey challenges everything they thought they knew about themselves and the world around them. Through this process, the Real Housewives will question if they can appreciate the lives they left behind and conversely, the real wives will question whether the aspirational lives showcased on reality TV are truly as glamorous as they appear.
title: Wife Swap: The Real Housewives Edition

overview: London, 1782. Tensions run high in the war between France and Britain. A young woman, Lucie Manette has her life upended when she receives a message from Paris - her father, assumed dead for almost 20 years, may be alive. The messenger - idealistic French emigré, Charles Darnay - is arrested and charged with treason. Lucie enlists the help of a brilliant but erratic young lawyer, Sydney Carton, to free Darnay in the hope he will lead her to Paris to track down her father. Lucie's collision with Darnay and Carton unleashes a powerful and complex love triangle. Both men fight to be worthy of her love, and Lucie is torn over which one to choose. Yet neither man - physically so alike, spiritually poles apart - can escape the other. Instead, they find themselves bound together in life and death, through triumphs, tragedies, marriage, and murder.
title: A Tale Of Two Cities

overview: The nostalgic series celebrates eight of America's most iconic television shows and the indelible mark they left on popular culture.
title: TV We Love

overview: Bruce Forsyth's Hot Streak is a fast-paced word-association game show in which two teams compete to build a chain of connected clues. Players try to think on their feet and keep the momentum going as teammates race to guess the final word before the streak is broken. Hosted by Bruce Forsyth, the series blends lively gameplay with Forsyth's trademark humour and showmanship.
title: Bruce Forsyth's Hot Streak

overview: Up the Elephant and Round the Castle is a British television sitcom starring comedian Jim Davidson, who played the role of Jim London. The show spawned a sequel, Home James!, which was also made by Thames Television. It aired on ITV from 30 November 1983 - 7 November 1985.
title: Up the Elephant and Round the Castle

overview: The Off Weeks follows writing professor Gus Adler, whose divorce has thrown his life into chaos. He struggles to hold things together during "on weeks" when he has custody of his kids. But in his "off weeks," he's falling dangerously in love with Stella West, a mysterious woman whose arrival puts Gus' on-week duties and off-weeks ambitions on a fatal collision course.
title: The Off Weeks

overview: The series shows the Hebe we all know and reveals her personal story: loves, disappointments, aspirations, opinions and her enormous influence that remains on our TV to this day.
title: Hebe: Um brinde à vida

overview: «Stal'nyye ispytaniya» is a competition for blade enthusiasts and collectors. Participants bring their finest specimens to prove the quality of their creations and their mastery of them in a series of three rounds.
title: Стальные испытания

overview: Adelina Tattilo is Mrs. Playmen, editor of Italy's first erotic magazine and a revolutionary force in the conservative, moralistic Rome of the 1970s. A pioneering entrepreneur in an era when women were confined to the roles of mothers and housewives; a devout Catholic, yet also a bold nonconformist, she stood at the forefront of battles for divorce, abortion rights, and women's emancipation. When her husband, Saro Balsamo, abandons her, leaving her alone to face creditors as the sole owner of an empire on the brink of collapse, Adelina refuses to give up. She reinvents Playmen, transforming it into a sophisticated and cutting-edge publication and, defying the entrenched sexism of the time, gathers around her a team of brilliant intellectuals, daring creatives, and visionary photographers. Together, they break taboos, provoke the establishment, and ignite a cultural revolution, issue after issue, scandal after scandal.
title: Mrs Playmen

overview: Especially for Father's Day, the O! channel is launching a new educational online show for children and parents called "Ask My Dad"! Our main experts—children—will bring their dads with interesting professions to our studio, where they will answer viewers' most original, funny, and unusual questions live on air.
title: Спроси моего папу

overview: Jeanne Nogarède is a police officer in her home village of Saint-Guilhem-le-Désert. The biggest regret of her life: the case of Emma Vivian, the daughter of one of her childhood friends, who disappeared on her way to school. Five years later, a new element shakes up her understanding of the case. Jeanne discovers online the video image reconstructed by an AI of the young Emma Vivian who explains what happened to her. However, her story contains an element that only her captor could know... or her mother.
title: La Disparue de Compostelle

overview: Eight Finns from different backgrounds try to survive in the Inari wilderness alone without amenities. The longest beneficiary of nature wins.
title: Alone Suomi

overview: Gary and the gang share their favourite books, meet the authors, and celebrate children's literature! From books to the alphabet to opposites, the CBC Kids Reads Collection has something for everyone!
title: CBC Kids Reads

overview: Ever wonder how common, everyday objects are made? Science Channel fan favorite HOW IT'S MADE returns for another season of exploring how many of the everyday objects or products we seldom stop to think about are made. From hockey pucks and hand saws to drill bits and frozen french fries, 'How It's Made' offers viewers a first-hand look at how these deceptively simple objects are constructed. Thousands of humdrum items are put to good use on a daily basis, but it's easy to overlook how things like aluminum ladders, firefighter helmets, matches and engine blocks are constructed. How It's Made: Dream Cars visits dozens of assembly lines where raw materials become finished products right before the viewers' eyes. In each episode of the series, viewers will be amazed to see how many common items are manufactured in high-tech factories around the world.
title: How It's Made: Dream Cars

overview: It's the spring of 2009, and Hanamura Construction, the largest general construction firm in Japan, is holding its annual welcome ceremony for its new grads. Sakura stands out from the rest of the talented bunch for clearly being a country bumpkin. Hailing from a small remote island up north, she came to Tokyo alone and has no qualms about sharing her dream of building a bridge to her home town.
title: Our Dearest Sakura

overview: With never-before-seen footage, never-before-told stories, and unique access to Jô's inner life, the series offers a thrilling and hilarious journey through his comedy shows, plays, and talk shows.
title: Um Beijo do Gordo

overview: Since childhood, Dong Min has been able to see ghosts. While searching for a new home, he encounters a breathtakingly handsome ghost—Seung Hun! "This house is mine." A ghost who refuses to leave, and a boy who can't help but fall for him.

overview: A novelist yearning for silence and a musician haunted by loneliness clash through the wall that separates them. What begins as a deal to quiet the noise turns into nights of passion, healing, and inspiration—where only each other's presence can protect them from the darkness.

overview: The documentary "Silvio Santos: Worth More Than Money" explores the many facets of the businessman and presenter: the generous leader, the family man, the innovative communicator. Friends, coworkers, his six daughters, and his wife, Iris Abravanel, share stories and reveal previously unknown details about the "Boss."
title: Silvio Santos: Vale Mais que Dinheiro!

overview: I can't stand my boss—he's the worst. But now he's under some weird ‘condition'… and the only way to break it is if I fall in love with him?!
title: My Team Leader Is Working Late Again

overview: A story of conflict, growth, and love begins when Yeon U, still holding on to past feelings for his senior U Jin, finds out that U Jin is now engaged to his sister.

overview: TRUE FILM's BL web drama
title: Connect

overview: A car accident leaves both Taekin, a high school outcast, and Heechan, a business owner, in the hospital. But Heechan has no time to sit around and enjoy his hospital bed. If he doesn't get up and make sure his clients get their products, his business will be in jeopardy! There's just one problem. After the accident, he now inhabits the body of this high school kid every day from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. Talk about an out of body experience! Heechan decides that the way to fix things is to go to Taekin's high school in the boy's body and sort things out himself! While looking for the source of their transformation, Heechan sees a familiar face from his own past. But who is going to believe this ridiculous scenario and help him out? Just how is Heechan going to get his body back?!
title: Half of Me

overview: Take Hart is a British children's television show about art, presented by Tony Hart. It took over from Vision On, and ran from 1977 until 1983. The show featured Hart and the animated Plasticine character Morph, and other characters created by David Sproxton like 'Smoulder the Moulder', which was a lump of mould which would create props by 'spraying' them out of a spray can. The only other human to appear on a regular basis was Mr Bennett, the caretaker, played by Colin Bennett. The programme won a BAFTA award for Hart in 1984.
title: Take Hart

overview: A sweet romantic love story blossoms at the perfume brand Hotel Dawson. Three guests visit Minjun, a brand employee. Minjun's heart races with excitement at their unique scents. Growing conflict, emotions, and a thrilling fragrance permeate Hotel Dawson.
title: Calentos

overview: i-camcorder showed camcorder users how to make those home movies have a more professional look.
title: i-camcorder

overview: When British art expert (cum art thief) Thomas Force and American mercenary Jennifer Majeure are recruited by an eccentric, justice-obsessed billionaire Amanda Daventry, they find themselves tasked with defeating the evil plans of international villains operating in the most fabulous locations across Europe. But as Force & Majeure team up to defeat the forces of evil, they must also work together to escape the clutches of Amanda, who may not be telling them the whole story.
title: Force & Majeure

overview: About Face, spotlights a team of elite Los Angeles-based plastic surgeons as they take on some of the most complex and medically challenging facial reconstruction cases. Drs. Roostaeian, Rovelo, and Panossian work at the cutting edge of reconstructive surgery, transforming the lives of patients suffering from severe facial deformities, traumatic injuries, and rare conditions, including massive tumors, extensive birthmarks, and disfiguring accidents. About Facecaptures the emotional and physical journeys of those who've been overlooked, misdiagnosed, or told nothing could be done. It's not just about changing appearances, it's about restoring dignity, hope, and humanity.
title: About Face

overview: Sarm Heslop disappeared from a luxury Caribbean charter yacht in 2021. Did she vanish of her own accord? Was there a terrible accident? Or did something more sinister happen?
title: Missing in Paradise: Searching for Sarm

overview: Discover the truth behind the world's wildest animal encounters. With over 8 billion people in every corner of the planet, it's no wonder we're getting closer to animals than ever before. And the tech in our pockets means EVERYTHING'S caught on camera. We all love to share these clips on social media, but there's WAY more to these stories than meets the eye.
title: Close Encounters of the Wild Kind

overview: Vision On was a British children's television programme, shown on BBC1 from 1964 to 1976 and designed specifically for deaf children. Vision On was conceived and developed by BBC producers Ursula Eason and Patrick Dowling to replace a monthly series For the Deaf, a programme paced slowly enough for children to read captions and subtitles.
title: Vision On

overview: A serial killer known as "Head Hunter" terrorized Makhwan until he attacked a family, and one child survived. This led to his capture—a married surgeon with a child on the way. Twenty-five years later, the survivor, Ramil, is a police officer and hunts criminals, including the new "Gold Leaf Killer", together with his colleague Wit. All clues point to Dr. Kan, but a violent confrontation ends with Wit seriously injured and Kan dead – and a shocking revelation about his origins. After his recovery, Wit returns, but something is different. What really happened? And how is it all connected to the Head Hunter?

overview: A gripping docuseries uncovering lost civilizations, vanished artifacts, and forgotten figures erased from history.

overview: Jerry Cala plays Enrico, an animator who becomes director of a tourist town in crisis.

The Heiress and Her Possessive Bodyguard

The program's dynamic pace is complemented by a voiceover that provides humorous and ironic commentary on the events taking place on camera.

overview: Amateurs a nine episodes long fictional series in the tragicomic story of the amateur theater company De Pajot spectrometers, which friendship and sincere naivety go hand in hand, full of warm characters and familiar situations. The story starts in a small parish hall in Leirbeek, where the enthusiastic Jan Delvo salle inspirer of the amateur theater company De Pajot heaters. Jan annually writes his own door comedy, what he has done this year with the new stage play 'aunt's sink Jos. John is convinced that this is the ticket for the Royal Landjuweel, the annual contest for the best amateur society, where they grab for years wide.With this new piece John hopes to finally follow in the footsteps of his father, who was there as the previous director indeed managed to win the prestigious award.
title: Amateurs

overview: Is love about restraint? Or instinct? A half-step back hides the struggle within; An embrace forward reveals the true heart.
title: The Secret of the Secretary

overview: Series looking at life from a kid's point of view, in which children are given camcorders to tell us about their lives and reveal their thoughts on a given topic.
title: Through Children's Eyes

overview: Laurence Llewelyn-Bowen unlocks the untold story of everyday homes to create a unique room renovation and show property owners how to resolve modern-day design dilemmas.
title: Laurence's Extraordinary Ordinary Houses

overview: A three-part docudrama commemorating the 80th anniversary of liberation, chronicling the battle in Zeeland and West Brabant. Dramatic scenes, archive footage, and animations reveal the power struggles behind the seemingly united Allied front and its devastating consequences for Zeeland.
title: Het grote offensief

overview: Every crime leaves a trail. Fingerprints, DNA, a move caught on camera. BBC News journalist Calum Leslie is joined by two experts - one who investigates how crimes are committed and one who digs into why. The team examines the evidence that led to convictions and put some of the UK's most notorious criminals behind bars. Gaining access to information that usually remains sealed, Cracking the Case gives professional insights into the psychological profile behind the criminal act and walks the audience through how the perpetrators were caught. At the heart of each episode lies a thorough exploration of the impact crime has on victims and their families - giving a voice to the people most profoundly impacted by terrible events by hearing directly from them.
title: Cracking the Case

overview: Xuxa Meneghel's eternal Paquitas revisit experiences on stage and screen.

overview: Reserved, intelligent, and generous, Leo has achieved professional success and now lives in seclusion in Serra da Cantareira, with his young wife, Karina. He discovers he's ill and decides to reconnect with old friends from the 1970s, with whom he fought against the military regime.
title: Queridos Amigos

overview: It accompanies Galvão on trips to important places in his career as a broadcaster. Japan, where Ayrton Senna won his third Formula 1 championship, and Brazil, his fifth, is one of them. The United States, where the Brazilian national team won its fourth championship, and Qatar, the country that hosted the last World Cup he covered on Globo, are also featured in the documentary.
title: Galvão: Olha o Que Ele Fez

overview: Several generations of the Kuznetsov family have been living under one roof. Vera, a mother with many children, her four children from three marriages, her current husband Vitya, a creative grandmother, and grandfather Valery Mikhalych, a former engineer at a defense enterprise, share one living space. Relatives manage to coexist without swearing until TV producers offer the family to participate in a reality show. Caught in the crosshairs of the cameras, each Kuznetsov shows his true colors.

overview: Comedy drama about a girl with a magic cookbook

overview: Ed Gamble is joined by the latest murdered and banished players to unpack all the drama from The Celebrity Traitors.

overview: From Cleopatra to Genghis Khan, Professor Suzannah Lipscomb uses cutting-edge science and compelling detective work to reveal the truth behind the deaths of history's most famous figures.

overview: At the centre of the game show are 13 candidates who try to play a dangerous game of truth and lies with the aim of exposing the hidden werewolves before they themselves are eliminated from the game. This is because three of the participants belong to the secret ‘werewolf' trio, who are doing everything they can to remain unrecognised and strategically eliminate the other candidates. Who is lying? Who can trust whom? Who will be the next to go?

At the center of the game is the clash between the "Righteous," who strive to build alliances and survive – and the "Traitors," who operate in the shadows, manipulating, eliminating, and striving to remain undetected until the end.

overview: Series shedding light on unusual discoveries made in the darkest places on Earth and venturing into the realm of the supernatural, where eerie and unsettling findings turn up unexplained phenomena that challenge man's understanding of the world.

overview: Charting the seasons in a wild and beautiful landscape, steeped in history and legend. From the foothills to the peaks, meet the people at the heart of mountainous mid-Ulster.

overview: The story of Paula Bernal a music enthusiast who earns a living playing live music at bars around Mexico City. Paula meets Rogelio Iturbide the two fall madly in love, get married, and decide to move to Rogelio's hometown of Morelia, without knowing how the Iturbide family would react to their union. Once in Morelia, the lovebirds are met by Rogelio's mother, Martina Rangel a very powerful and traditional woman who the locals refer to as La Monarca de Morelia and is profoundly resistant to Rogelio's newfound cosmopolitan view on life. Martina, feeling threatened by Paula's influence over her son, declares war on her new daughter-in-law and will stop at nothing to split them up.
title: Eternamente Amándonos

overview: Love is a Many Splendored Thing was adapted as a daytime drama from the 1955 movie of the same name. The series would largely focus on the Donnelly and Elliot families.
title: Love Is a Many Splendored Thing

overview: Talkshow with Schmidt and Pocher.

overview: Ruediger Bunz, a clerk in an electronic store, has to manage the struggles of being a TV starlet, after he stars as "the everyday man" in an schnaps-advert.

overview: Kurt Krömer interviews various celebrities.

overview: Uri Geller is searching for his successor in the new ProSieben show "The Next Uri Geller " For over 35 years, he has been the world's most famous mystifier. He effortlessly bent spoons, got stopped clocks running again, and read the most secret thoughts. Anyone who follows in his footsteps will need to bring a lot to the table: exceptional skills, charisma, and entertainment qualities. Who will captivate the audience and convince Uri Geller?
title: The Next Uri Geller

overview: Christmas Through the Decades is going back in time to see what Christmas and the holiday season were like in America not too long ago. Through experts and cultural icons offering their own insight and personal memories, Christmas Through the Decades will reveal how classic holiday films, fads, television specials, songs, and toys are still part of modern holiday celebration.

overview: Red Alert follows several civilians whose stories intertwine as they experienced the atrocities of October 7, including Bat Sheva (Rotem Sela), a mother forced to flee with her two daughters as her son is taken into Gaza; Ohad (Miki Leon), a father who becomes a tragic symbol of sacrifice as he fiercely protects his family; Ayoub (Hisham Suleiman), a grieving father who loses his wife and is forced to hide with his baby behind enemy lines; Nofar (Chen Amsalem), a Border Police officer caught in the massacre and injured while defending others, alongside colleague Liat (Rotem Abuhav); Kobi (Israel Atias), an anti-terrorism officer who runs directly into hell to save his wife; and Tali (Sara Vino), a devoted mother who transforms into an unlikely hero while searching for her injured son, Itamar (Nevo Katan).
title: Red Alert

overview: In this crime-solving reality show, players take on the roles of detectives and suspects. With clues and wits, can they expose the culprit among them?
